Container.Name: undocked-launcher
Container.Overview: Undocked Launcher is a homelab dashboard for Unraid. It auto-discovers all running Docker containers and displays them as a clean dark-themed grid with one-tap access via Cloudflare, Tailscale, and direct IP:port. Supports FolderView Plus grouping and automatically reads Tailscale hostnames set in the Unraid Docker manager.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Undocked Launcher web interface.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — required for container auto-discovery. Must be read-only.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Stores your settings (host IP, Cloudflare domain, Tailscale tailnet, custom apps).

Config.Name: Unraid Docker Templates
Config.Description: Used to auto-detect the Tailscale hostname configured for each container in the Unraid Docker manager.

Config.Name: FolderView Plus Config
Config.Description: Used to group containers using your existing FolderView Plus folder assignments. Requires the FolderView Plus Unraid plugin.
